limitations: Bounded reference covers only this exact model and direct Currys purchases; other products or retailers are not assessed.
Claimants must be UK residents aged 18 or over purchasing for consumer use (§§2, 4).
Graded, ex-display, seconds, imperfect and replacement products are excluded; cancelled or returned purchases do not qualify (§4).
Purchase must be directly from the participating retailer own stores or website, excluding marketplace sellers (§3.2).
No concurrent promoter offers; one claim per model and maximum five per household (§§4, 5).
The five-field request cannot check claimant identity, residency, age, product condition, seller, serial, proof submission, previous claims or payment details.
